The '''Mark 3/S Medium Blaster Cannon''' was manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] It was the main weapon employed on the [[Imperial Repulsortank 1-L]] and [[Imperial Repulsortank 1-M]].
